crowd.note: Sparse reaction only; not a sustained crowd-bed substitute.

cascade.provenance: Boxel Blitz donor grammar / Match Three shared source

storm.note: Deterministic filtered-noise + low-rumble stress accent derived from the existing Travel procedural-audio approach. It tests mix headroom only and is not an accepted thunder asset.

golden-hour-town.label: Golden Hour / Town
golden-hour-town.summary: Open world bed, a local water source and the Orc street band at conversational distance.
golden-hour-town.voice: FrizzleBob here. The band keeps playing. The town keeps breathing. I only take the front of the mix for a moment.

graveyard-night.label: Graveyard / Night
graveyard-night.summary: Sparse night state. Wind and negative space do most of the work; music stays on the timeline but nearly disappears.
graveyard-night.voice: Quiet is part of the soundscape. You should hear me without the graveyard turning itself off.

ring-performance.label: Ring / Performance
ring-performance.summary: Dense stress state: foreground Orc band, crowd reactions, impacts, storm accent and addressed speech.
ring-performance.voice: FrizzleBob on the mic. Keep the band running, keep the impact readable, and make this sentence intelligible without killing the room.
